text_block_list.text:
Brushing aside any worries that being the 
race favorite would get to her head, 
Daitaku Helios pulls off a brilliant 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
DJ Heli is legit unreal, right?! Totally 
delivered on what the floor was hyping 
for~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Well, I am the race favorite after 
all! Total rep-today vibes! So, with that 
said—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, I'm heading out to the paddock 
for MC time, so Train-pi, you handle the 
party poppers, 'kay!
choice_data_list:
No, the racecourse staff will get mad at 
us...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All goood! I checked with the staff-chan 
too! They said ten minutes is totally 
okay☆

Though she seemed simply carried away, she 
had actually planned everything out 
carefully. Seeing her grow like this 
filled me with joy.
